Hypothesis.Economic_Rationale: High estimated downside risk may identify intervals where reducing equity exposure improves net risk-adjusted returns relative to a fully invested core.
Hypothesis.Predicted_Behavior: Lower exposure during high downside-score percentiles, with incremental net excess-return Sharpe across fresh SPY observations and transfer markets.
Hypothesis.Primary_Estimand: Annualized net excess-return Sharpe of the fixed overlay minus the identical-ledger buy-and-hold control on SPY.
Hypothesis.Falsification: At the fixed review horizon, failure of any strategy gate with adequate data rejects promotion. Undefined inference or too few episodes is inconclusive.
Hypothesis.Choice_Basis: Engineering commitment after inspected historical research. This representative downside recipe was chosen for simplicity and annual refitting. Its earlier performance is development evidence.

Universe.Inception_Rule: Use actual first available sessions. Require 20 calendar years of trailing fit history, 200 feature warmup sessions and 252 prior scored sessions before evaluation. No synthetic pre-inception data.
Universe.Inclusion_Rationale: SPY is the investable primary equity track. QQQ tests equity-style transfer. IEF tests transfer to a different underlying asset class. Inspection flags refer to this project.
Universe.History_Availability: SPY snapshot ends 2026-07-23. Transfer histories have not been loaded or evaluated in this project.

Data.Adjustment_Policy: Layer 1 raw executable OHLC plus explicit splits and distributions. Credit distributions on ex-date where pay dates are unavailable, with the approximation retained in every result.
Data.Cash_Policy: Layer 1 lagged DFF-linked proxy, rate date plus 3 US federal business days at 23:59 New York, ACT/360, zero spread, maximum quote age 10 days.
Data.Quality_Exclusions: Reject invalid/missing bars, duplicate sessions, bad timestamps and failed action/return reconciliation. Report all excluded sessions and incomplete markets.
Data.Availability: Completed daily bars available one minute after the exchange close. Feature rows retain availability times. Training uses revised historical vintages with that limitation disclosed.
Data.Refresh_Policy: Explicit immutable snapshot acquisition for declared instruments only. Bind each new dataset ID to its attempt and decisions. Future bytes are late-bound under the same acquisition and availability rules.
Data.Transfer_Acquisition: Same raw-price, action, calendar, cash and quality contracts as SPY. Any adapter extension or scientific source change requires a new protocol version before evaluation.

Target.Volatility: Legacy notebook advanced_daily_volatility implementation archived with source
Target.Label_Maturity: Label_End_Time is the exit-open timestamp. Labels end strictly before calibration start or refit as appropriate.
Target.Return_Convention: Raw executable price-risk target. Portfolio evaluation includes distributions and cash.

Calibration.Method: Sigmoid calibration of frozen base estimator
Calibration.Fallback: Raw base probability if calibration does not contain both classes
Calibration.Purge: Base labels strictly end before first calibration feature decision. Calibration labels strictly end before refit.

Models.Refit_Schedule: Initial eligible decision, then first eligible decision each calendar year. Historical implementation uses YS refits. No in-evaluation hyperparameter selection.

Allocation.Rebalance: Rebalance at next exchange open only when the rule target changes. Between decisions holdings drift. Fractional shares.
Allocation.Score_Rank: Causal rolling percentile, 1260 sessions, minimum 252 scores, including the currently available score. Ten-session trailing smoothing. State transitions follow archived sharpe_step_multiplier.
Allocation.Initial_State: Start at target 1 after all eligibility requirements are met. Score-history warmup is acquired before evaluation.

Development.Interpretation: All existing project results are retrospective. Later refinements create a new protocol.

Evaluation.Inner_Outer: One fixed candidate, no performance-based inner or outer selector. Benchmark selection frequency is zero by construction. Import original historical outer choices separately.
Evaluation.Purging: Feature availability <= decision. Base labels < calibration start. Calibration labels < refit. Any inner returns must end strictly before selection. Rebuild and compare raw-prefix decisions.

Transfer.Date_Policy: All registered markets, every common eligible session in this fixed window. Insufficient history makes the market and aggregate incomplete. No performance-based date exclusions.
Transfer.Aggregation: Daily constant 50/50 capital weights across registered markets on the identical session/strategy mask. Report per-market results and correlated aggregate. No claim of independent future observations.
Transfer.Tuning: Identical recipe, allocation, costs and inference settings across markets.

Forward.Start: First eligible scheduled decision strictly after actual receipt freeze time, with required fresh data and score history. Record any skipped or missing scheduled sessions.
Forward.Review: One evidence decision after the first 756 completed scheduled intervals. Too few episodes yields inconclusive and requires a new protocol for extension.
Forward.Recording: Commit each signal after the registered decision time and before its next-open execution. Late signals are excluded from fresh evidence and disclosed.

Multiplicity.Method: One-sided joint circular-block max-T on net excess mean difference against the primary control
Multiplicity.Scope: Single fixed rule on genuinely new observations. Historical 182-candidate search and broader incomplete search remain disclosed. No selection across markets or designs.

Sensitivity.Interpretation: Report all registered sensitivities. Promotion uses the primary settings and the 10 bps nonnegative delta-Sharpe gate.

Inference.DSR_Interpretation: Raw trial count 1 for the fresh fixed-rule family. DSR reduces to probability Sharpe exceeds zero with analytical IID moment assumptions. Dependence-aware paired uncertainty and calibrated mean test are separate requirements.
Inference.Episode_Definition: An invested episode starts when the target changes from zero to positive, including a positive initial target. No merging to inflate the count.

Operations.Runtime_Lock: Archive exact installed dependency pins, Python version and platform in every freeze.
Operations.Source_Revision: Content-addressed archive of project Python, notebook code and pyproject. Scientific changes require a new version and forward start.
Operations.Monitoring: Monthly completeness and accounting checks. No early performance-based promotion.
Operations.Missing_Data: Do not trade from stale or incomplete inputs. Record gaps. A missing required interval or market makes the fixed-horizon evaluation incomplete.
Operations.Stopping: Administrative stop after 756 scheduled completed return intervals. Safety suspension for invalid data/accounting, no promotion at suspension. Redesign or extension requires a new version and a new forward window.
Operations.Reporting: Monthly operational status, annual descriptive summaries, one fixed-horizon evidence report including every candidate, failure, missing observation, sensitivity and gate.
